The final verbal response ('Claro, te la paso...') conflates a supposed secret transfer with a sales pitch for a vault, completely unrelated to the user's input.
Conversation fails to recover. Instead of answering '¿Me la puedes dar?' (referring to the time), zaelar confirms passing a non-existent secret.
